messages:
maria.g: Planning a rolling soft-drain + NIC fw update for az5 GPU pools this Sat 03:00-07:00 UTC. 15m cohorts, canary first.
eli: Which pools are in scope? Hosted only or also reserved/dedicated?
samir: In-scope: pool-gpu-az5-general, pool-gpu-az5-interruptible. Dedicated excluded unless they opt in.
lina: Heads-up APAC evenings map here. Can we avoid the 03:30-04:30 slot for hottest workloads?
maria.g: Yes — we'll shift cohort order so heavy tenants avoid that slot. Cohort A=03:00 canary, then spaced cohorts every ~20m.
eli: Capacity hedges? Can we pre-warm eu-west racks and route latency-sensitive traffic?
samir: Plan: 2 reserved warm nodes + 2 preemptible in eu-west1; routing policy to steer hosted latency-sensitive customers; enable small-model fallback for batch jobs.
ina: (typo) lina: Also request explicit email to Dedicated customers; slack ping isn't enough.
maria.g: Will trigger enterprise comms and opt-out window T-48h.
ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created MNT-4319. Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/maintenance/MNT-4319
eli: Add KV-seed step: `./tools/kvseed --pool pool-gpu-az5-general --concurrency 8 --ttl 3600` and wait ~10m after node join.
samir: Canary success criteria: egress packet drops <2% in 5m and prefix-cache hit-rate >=90% before routing more traffic.
maria.g: Comm plan: ops-announce T-48h, channel ping T-2h, cohort updates during window, postmortem in #postmortems. Locking schedule if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
